Question 6
?

A particle moves from the origin with an acceleration of 6ikm/h2 and an initial velocity of −5jkm/h. Find the position vector of the particle after 3 hours.

a
(27i−15j)km
b
(−6i−18j)km
c
(7i+10j)km
d
(9i+5j)km
e
(−5i−14j)km
